premises.text: Over 90% of RF energy transmitted by phones is lost to the environment and can be harvested
premises.evidence_span: over 90% of that energy is lost into the environment

premises.text: A smartphone case with a proprietary harvesting antenna converts wasted RF into electricity returned to the phone
premises.evidence_span: Our case is embedded with a harvesting antenna that is proprietary that captures that wasted RF energy

premises.text: The case passively extends battery life by about 30% without plugging in, unlike battery cases and portable chargers
premises.evidence_span: extend your battery life by 30% simply using wasted energy transmitted from your phone

premises.text: A case is the right first form factor because many smartphone users already buy power accessories
premises.evidence_span: over 30% have purchased some sort of product to help them get a little more power in their phone

value.text: Extra passive battery power for mobile devices from sunup to sundown
value.evidence_span: gives you extra power that you need to get from sunup to sundown

secondary_value.text: Path toward ubiquitous wireless power and 100% mobility

notes: Wireless charger roadmap and IoT sensor future folded as vision into secondary_value, not separate premises (§4.1(4)/(5)). Kickstarter launch timing excluded as financing/traction. OSU partnership treated as bio/credibility.
